# CrewSignal

CrewSignal is a software platform that helps small service businesses, such as contractors, salons, and barbershops, automatically request Google reviews from their customers after a job is completed.

## What CrewSignal does
After a business marks a job complete in their existing CRM or booking software (currently Square, QuickBooks Online, or Wave), CrewSignal automatically sends one text message to that customer with a thank-you and a link to leave a Google review. Businesses do not need to remember to ask, and customers are not contacted more than once per completed job.

## Who it's for
Field service contractors (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, fencing, decks) and appointment-based service businesses (salons, barbershops, studios) who want more Google reviews without manually following up with every customer.

## Key facts
- Works with: Square, QuickBooks Online, and Wave
- One message sent per completed job, never repeated for the same job
- Every message includes a STOP opt-out instruction; replying START/UNSTOP/YES re-enables messages
- Published tiered pricing based on team size: Solo (1-2 people), Team (3-7 people), and Business (8-12 people) plans, each with a standard rate and a discounted, life-of-account Founding Member rate for early customers. See the pricing section at getcrewsignal.com for current numbers.
- Operated by Brandon Myles, Middle Tennessee, USA
